verdict.rationale: cubic supports some bulk-like operations — codebase scans that 'deploy thousands of AI agents to find bugs across your repository' (cubic-docs-21), cross-repo reviews that check for related changes across multiple repos (cubic-docs-37/46), and analytics/CSV exports of PR-level data across a team (cubic-docs-19, cubic-docs-20) — but these are review/scan/export operations, not a general-purpose bulk-action capability (e.g., batch-fixing or batch-approving many PRs/items at once) with independent confirmation of scale. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a bulk-action command/API for acting on many PRs, issues, or files simultaneously, and independent/hands-on evidence corroborating the 'thousands of agents' claim at scale.
